headline: Angara Calls for Stronger Student Support After Ateneo de Zamboanga Shooting
seoTitle: Angara Calls for Stronger Student Support After Zamboanga Shooting | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News evening brief reports Education Secretary Sonny Angara's visit to Ateneo de Zamboanga and a push for stronger student mental-health and socio-emotional support after the shooting.
deck: The education response shifts attention from physical security alone toward counseling, support systems and prevention.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News evening package reports that Education Secretary Sonny Angara visited Ateneo de Zamboanga after the fatal campus shooting and called for stronger school support for students.

The package frames the response around mental-health and socio-emotional services. FMB News is not presenting the package's strongest 'nationwide overhaul' wording as a completed policy unless formal implementing details are issued.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The shooting has prompted parallel discussions about school safety, firearm custody, student welfare and the role of families and communities in prevention.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Stronger counseling and support systems may help schools identify distress earlier, but implementation depends on staffing, referral capacity, training and resources.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DepEd for formal policy issuances, funding, staffing plans and measurable changes to counseling and student-support programs.
